overview_description: Create, change, cancel and read purchase orders, their lines, notes, files and KPIs, and the purchase invoices and payments raised from them.
intro: A purchase order records what you are buying from a supplier. These endpoints create, update, change, cancel and reactivate purchase orders, read their lines, KPIs, purchase invoices and payments, and manage their notes and attached files. This area has 23 endpoints, each available in all seven SDKs.
warning: **Deleting a purchase order or a note cannot be undone.** Cancel a purchase order instead if you may need it again. Deleting a note file currently returns `404`.
notes: **Every JSON write body is wrapped in `purchase_order`.** The exceptions are the purchase invoice create, wrapped in `purchase_invoice`, and the note create, a multipart form; the cancel and reactivate calls take an empty object.
**The note calls take the purchase order's `code`, not its `id`.** That covers listing, creating, reading and deleting notes and their files.
**A new purchase order is `active`.** Send `"draft": true` in the create body to save it as a draft instead.
**Cancelling sets the status to `inactive`.** Reactivating sets it back to `active`.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records are under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` while `pagination.has_more` is `true`.
**Notes are created as a multipart form.** The text goes in the `note` field, and a file is optional.

endpoints.title: List purchase orders
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of purchase orders.
endpoints.description: Lists the purchase orders on the account, one page at a time. The records are under `data` and the paging details under `pagination`; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` to read the next page. Other fields filter the list as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Create a purchase order
endpoints.summary: Creates a purchase order for a supplier and returns it under `purchase_order`.
endpoints.description: Creates a purchase order from a supplier and its lines, wrapped in `purchase_order`. Name an existing supplier with `account_id`, or send `account` to create the supplier in the same call. A line takes an existing item by `item_id`, or a new one by `item_name` with a price under `item_price_snapshot`. The new order is `active`; send `"draft": true` to create a draft instead.

account.description: A new supplier account to create with the order. Send `account_id` instead to use an existing one.

account_id.description: The `id` of an existing supplier account.

draft.description: `true` creates the purchase order with status `draft`.

item_name.description: The name of an item that does not exist yet.

item_price_snapshot.description: The unit price for a new item, under `pricing_rule.price`.

item_id.description: The `id` of an existing item, instead of `item_name`.

endpoints.title: List notes across purchase orders
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of notes from every purchase order.
endpoints.description: Lists the notes of all purchase orders together, one page at a time, under `data`. Use the per-order notes list to see one purchase order's notes. Other fields filter the list as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: One page of purchase order notes.

endpoints.title: Delete a purchase order
endpoints.summary: Deletes a purchase order. Nothing comes back.
endpoints.description: Deletes the purchase order. The call returns `204` with no body, and reading the purchase order afterwards returns `404`.

parameters.name: purchase_order_id
parameters.description: The purchase order's `id`.

endpoints.title: Update a purchase order
endpoints.summary: Changes header fields of a purchase order and returns it under `purchase_order`.
endpoints.description: Updates fields of the purchase order, such as `purchase_order_note`, wrapped in `purchase_order`. The updated purchase order comes back under `purchase_order`. To add or change lines, use the change call.

parameters.name: purchase_order_id
parameters.description: The purchase order's `id`.

purchase_order_note.description: A note printed on the purchase order.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a purchase order
endpoints.summary: Returns one purchase order under `purchase_order`.
endpoints.description: Returns the purchase order with its supplier, totals, status and KPIs under `purchase_order`. Its lines are listed by the lines call.

parameters.name: purchase_order_id
parameters.description: The purchase order's `id`.

404.description: No purchase order has that `id`, for example after it is deleted.

endpoints.title: Cancel a purchase order
endpoints.summary: Cancels a purchase order and returns it under `purchase_order`.
endpoints.description: Cancels the purchase order, which sets its status to `inactive`. Send an empty object as the body. Reactivate it with the reactivate call.

parameters.name: purchase_order_id
parameters.description: The purchase order's `id`.

endpoints.title: Change a purchase order's lines
endpoints.summary: Adds or changes lines on a purchase order and returns it under `purchase_order`.
endpoints.description: Changes the lines of the purchase order, wrapped in `purchase_order.lines`. Each entry has an `op`: `add` with an `item_id` and `item_quantity` adds a line, and `change` with the line's `id` written as a UUID (drop the prefix before `_` and add dashes in the 8-4-4-4-12 pattern) changes its quantity or price.

parameters.name: purchase_order_id
parameters.description: The purchase order's `id`.

op.description: `add` to add a line, or `change` to change one.

uuid.description: For `change`: the line's `id` written as a UUID: drop the prefix before `_` and add dashes in the 8-4-4-4-12 pattern.

item_id.description: For `add`: the `id` of the item to add.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a purchase order's information
endpoints.summary: Returns the header information of one purchase order under `purchase_order`.
endpoints.description: Returns the purchase order's header fields, such as its dates, totals, status and custom attributes, under `purchase_order`, without the supplier, currency and KPI blocks.

parameters.name: purchase_order_id
parameters.description: The purchase order's `id`.

endpoints.title: Create a purchase order note
endpoints.summary: Adds a note, with an optional file, to a purchase order and returns it under `note`.
endpoints.description: Adds a note to the purchase order. Send a multipart form with the text as the `note` field and, optionally, a file to attach. Address the purchase order by its `code`. The new note comes back under `note`.

parameters.name: purchase_order_id
parameters.description: The purchase order's `code`. The note calls address a purchase order by its code.

note.description: The note text. HTML is accepted.

file.description: An optional file to attach to the note.

endpoints.title: Create a purchase invoice from a purchase order
endpoints.summary: Raises a purchase invoice for a purchase order and returns it under `purchase_invoice`.
endpoints.description: Creates a purchase invoice from the purchase order's lines. Send `{"purchase_invoice": {}}` as the body. The new invoice is `active` and appears in the purchase order's purchase invoices list.

parameters.name: purchase_order_id
parameters.description: The purchase order's `id`.

endpoints.summary: Returns the KPI figures of one purchase order under `purchase_order_kpis`.
endpoints.description: Returns the purchase order's KPIs, such as `total_purchase_invoice`, `total_outstanding` and `total_overdue`, under `purchase_order_kpis`. The same figures come with the purchase order as `kpis`.

parameters.name: purchase_order_id
parameters.description: The purchase order's `id`.

endpoints.title: Delete a purchase order note file
endpoints.summary: Removes one attachment from a purchase order note. Nothing comes back.
endpoints.description: Deletes one file from the note. Address the purchase order by its `code` and the file by its `uuid`. The call returns `204` with no body.
endpoints.warning: **Deleting a note file currently fails.** This call currently returns `404` "attachment not found", even for a file the note's file list shows.

parameters.name: purchase_order_id
parameters.description: The purchase order's `code`. The note calls address a purchase order by its code.

parameters.name: purchase_order_note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`, from the note create or the notes list.

parameters.name: purchase_order_file_id
parameters.description: The attachment's `uuid`, from the note's `attachments`.

204.description: The file is removed from the note.

404.description: Attachment not found. This call currently returns `404` for every attachment, including ones the note's file list shows.

limit.description: The page size the API applied.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to read the next page.

prev_cursor.description: The cursor of the previous page.
